title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE omits key_exportable for KEY fds
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info has no 'exportable' field. ioctl_get_state() fills key_type for KEY fds but silently drops key_exportable. A caller holding a KEY fd cannot determine exportability from GET_STATE alone — they must call KEY_GET_INFO. This is a diagnostic gap: a debugger inspecting fd state cannot answer 'is this key exportable?' from GET_STATE output. Adding the field later is an ABI-breaking struct resize.
close_reason: fixed: added __u32 key_exportable to crypto2dev_fd_state_info; populated from state->key_exportable in ioctl_get_state KEY branch
